properties.description: I've always wondered what the inside of vending machine looks like
My first bowl of Ramen in Japan
This ramen had 3 cuts of meet (chicken breast,  pork shoulder and beef) and 2 wonton dumplings.
This petshop had a vending machine specially for buying birthday cakes for dogs.
Cold udon breakfast at the airport
Hachiya Ramen, a pungent anchovy-based soup topped with black garlic oil.
The view from my hotel over Asahikawa station
Genghis Kahn - grilled lamb.  Apparently named so because the grill looks like a mongol hat

Cafe I stopped off in to warm up after trudging through now for 2 hours
Please do not stub your massive novelty-sized cigarette in this childs face.
Otaru - once Hokkaido's main port,  now a popular tourist destination
My ferry to Niigata. The waves were 5m high!
There was no wifi - just this TV playing Colombo poorly dubbed into Japanese
The public bath on the boat.  It had an open-air section!
My tiny cabin.  No door just a pull-down blind
I ended up chatting with the locals in this Izakaya. They were bemused as to why I was "sightseeing" in Niigata.
They really know how to do drain covers here
This shinkansen had broken down and there were literally 5 news helicopers circling overhead and a crowd of people taking photos
Sapporo ramen - Miso,  butter and sweetcorn
